purpose: Fleet-wide notification rule inventory, configuration insights, inline rename, bulk management, export, and query-selected existing-rule editing.
primaryGoal: Find and safely manage existing rules without losing configuration, delivery routing, typed thresholds, or rule scope.

dataSources.behavior: AbortSignal forwarded; stable notificationKeys.alertRules; safeArray selection. Loaded inventory drives counts, insights, client-side filters, table, and edit lookup.

dataSources.behavior: Independent channel source; AbortSignal forwarded. Supplies filter options and editor routing/test targets.
Typed payloads, mutation toasts, invalidateAndBroadcast of rule and pack-installation queries. Bulk deletion currently uses parallel per-ID deletes rather than the registered bulk delete endpoint.

dataSources.behavior: Only existing-rule editing is mounted here. Controller consumes the selected workspace vehicle for signal metadata, explicit rule vehicle scope for business configuration, computed metric definitions, saved preferences, and test targets.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three insight panels repeat localized title, loading skeleton, fatal-error retry and empty-state CTA; both bar panels repeat MetricBar lists.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If decomposition is undertaken, extract feature-local presentation panels with explicit loading/error/empty props and preserve all three independent bodies. Do not propose a new global widget without a second independent consumer.

issues.detail: Table caller supplies mobileColumns=['name','severity','status'] but no mobilePresentation/detail contract. The shared contract explicitly hides type, subject and scope columns below 768px. Equivalent in-table mobile access to those fields is not established; the rule editor is a separate reachable configuration view, not proof of table detail parity.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobile presentation/detail API, or a proven complete-data scroll strategy, retaining type/subject/scope, selection, sort, filters and export. Verify long rule/channel names and all supported widths.

states.initialLoading: Rules: no-retained-data gate at :135; brief loading at :564; three insight skeletons and table skeleton rows. Editor shows skeleton at :517.
states.empty: Each insight retains its panel and localized creation CTA; table has no-rules CTA at :759-772 and filtered-empty message at :807. Missing/invalid rule query gets dedicated not-found recovery at :526-531.
states.fatalError: rulesState.fatalError is the replacement criterion at :136-138; each source surface offers refetch. Editor preserves same criterion.
states.retainedRefreshError: Rules retained through useDataState; StaleRefreshWarning is present at :516 and :548. Brief includes provenance/update timestamp at :575.
states.offline: Known inherited impossible DataStatus comparison at :570 and :573; documented as diagnostic only below. Initial paused reads may have no loading/error presentation; source contract uses isRefreshBlocked, not an offline DataStatus member.
states.mutations: Enable/disable rejected requests retain selection; deletion uses allSettled then clears selection; rename uses save mutation; destructive confirmation exists.

issues.detail: Known inherited comparison of rulesState.status to 'offline' also occurs at :573. DataStatus has no offline member; paused/offline refresh is represented by isRefreshBlocked and retained status=stale. Source confirms a type-contract mismatch, not a newly executed compiler result.
issues.fix: Future owning implementation should consume isRefreshBlocked and existing shared offline presentation without adding an offline union member or weakening typing. No correction is authorized by this audit.

issues.detail: Channel filter is disabled on channelsQuery.isError even when channelsQuery.data retains usable channels; :749-750 uses generic QueryError rather than retained channel trust presentation. Independent rules content survives, but the filter cannot use retained channel data after a refresh failure.
issues.fix: Adapt channel query through existing useDataState; show nonblocking stale/paused warning and keep retained filter options usable, replacing only the never-loaded source on fatal error.

issues.detail: Resolved bulk enable/disable responses clear all selected keys without inspecting optional failed rows. Hooks type failed:[{id,reason}] but onSuccess reports only updated count. A partial result can leave no per-row explanation or retained failed selection.
issues.fix: Preserve failed IDs for retry and display concrete partial-result details through existing feedback. Define outcome handling jointly with hook owner; preserve invalidation and success/error toasts.
issues.limitations: Actual backend partial-result payload and UI outcome were not exercised.

issues.detail: Bulk delete discards Promise.allSettled outcomes and clears all selected keys even for rejected per-ID deletions. Individual hook toasts exist, but failed IDs are not retained for retry. The adjacent claim that there is no bulk delete route is stale relative to router registration.
issues.fix: Retain failed IDs and actionable result details. Evaluate the existing registered bulk delete contract separately before replacing the per-ID mutation path; do not silently change deletion behavior during visual modernization.

visualIssues.detail: Local hardcoded severity/status hex palettes compete with semantic token ownership; snoozed uses purple and disabled amber independently of the actual badges. Top subjects use categorical chart series. Bar callers inherit gradient fill despite an existing solid option.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse restrained existing semantic/chart token colors, retain textual counts and overlapping snooze semantics, and opt into MetricBar fill=solid. Do not add a new palette, change saved chart preferences, or invent severity meanings.
visualIssues.limits: Source styling observation only; composed intensity/contrast is unverified.

visualIssues.detail: Rule links and all four section icons use fixed text-cyan-300 instead of theme-aware semantic text/icon tokens. This does not automatically establish a contrast failure but bypasses theme-specific text treatment.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware link/accent semantics for actionable rule names; use subdued semantic or neutral tokens for decorative section icons. Preserve underline/focus and localized accessible names.

architectureIssues.detail: The 816-line orchestrator contains derived inventory analytics, table rendering/export, bulk outcomes, and insight presentation. It already has a proper feature-owned editor and shared table/chart/brief, so the issue is bounded local orchestration density, not a need for another framework.
architectureIssues.fix: If modernized, move insight/table presentation into feature-local components and isolate typed inventory derivation without altering counts, filters, table identity, exports or mutation semantics. Keep the page-plus-extracted-component preservation baseline.

priority.note: Inherited offline comparison is diagnostic-only and is not a source-edit instruction. No modernization or runtime acceptance is claimed.

actions: Filter automatic, no-external and explicit channels
Sort name, subject, severity and enabled status
Bulk enable/disable with pending presentation and failure selection retention
Persist table column visibility, ordering, resizing and page settings
Paginate and export rule rows as alert-rules
Edit all existing rule kinds and rule configuration
Save update, send test, cancel through dirty guard

data: Six metrics are based on all loaded rules before search/channel filtering; missing inventory stays null, not zero.
Snoozed is an overlapping browser-time predicate, not a mutually exclusive third enabled/disabled partition.
Severity uses normalizeSeverity; unknown noncritical/nonwarn entries enter the existing info aggregate. Preserve behavior pending a separately authorized business change.
Subject identifies signal, metric, system component/transition, or place/transition; top six preserve source strings and ordering.
Automatic channel routing is null; no external channels is []; explicit filtering also includes automatically routed rules.
Rule ID, all_vehicles, vehicle_ids and channel_ids are business configuration; do not replace with workspace display scope.
Preserve URL rule lookup, edit lease alert-rules/list, retained-query trust, abort signals, query keys, invalidation/broadcast and mutation feedback.
Preserve tableId notifications:alert-rules and export name/kind/subject/severity/scope/status values; do not silently remove mobile columns or exports.
Editor retains typed values, unit metadata and canonical SI payload behavior, trigger mode, cooldown, repeat limits, escalation, templates/messages and test targets.
Preserve existing saved preferences, dirty navigation/discard behavior and auth/demo/live-only mutation boundaries; no production mutation was run.
This is rule configuration, not date-scoped telemetry history. No duplicate page date or workspace vehicle selector is introduced; explicit business vehicle scope remains in editor.
